life.title: His life
life.lede: From Bethlehem to the ascension, on the map where it happened. The gospels are not diaries — this ordering follows a traditional harmony, and every event links straight to its own text.

map.keyboardShortcutsText: Tab to move between events. Enter / Space to expand an event's text. Use the place selector to highlight a place on the map and update the current-stop card.
map.experienceText: Begin with the clear atlas, or enter the terrain to follow the journey through elevation and distance.

map.routeBoundary: The line connects documented stops in narrative order; it does not claim a precise ancient road.

narrative.title: Text-only journey narrative
narrative.sectionTitle: Journey through the life of Jesus: A text narrative
narrative.intro: For screen reader users or those preferring a text-based guide, here is a chronological journey through Jesus' life with descriptions of each location, modern place names, and geographic directions. Each event is placed in its biblical and archaeological context.
narrative.travel: Travel: From the previous location, travel {direction} approximately {distance} km ({distanceMiles} mi).
narrative.geographicOverviewText: Jesus' ministry spans from Nazareth in the Galilee region northward to Caesarea Philippi, and southward through Samaria, the Jordan valley, and finally to Jerusalem and the Judean regions. The map window covers the area from the coast of Lebanon and the Mediterranean Sea in the west to the Golan Heights and Transjordan in the east, and from the southern Galilee to the Judean hills.
narrative.narrativeNote: The narrative follows the Gospel accounts, which emphasize Galilee as the site of Jesus' public ministry and Jerusalem as the place of his passion and resurrection. Modern archaeological research continues to refine the identification of biblical sites with contemporary locations.
